mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT parent.run_id FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs parent JOIN agent_runtime_executions execution ON execution.tenant_id=parent.tenant_id AND execution.run_id=parent.run_id WHERE parent.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND parent.cancelled AND parent.status='CANCELLED' AND parent.phase='FINISHED' AND execution.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','LOOP_TERMINATED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY parent.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
